description: Docs gap: the gateway proxy-endpoint CREATE body omits `ips`, but the wire API requires a CIDR string list when creating an ip-kind endpoint (v0 modeled ips: string[]; PATCH documents it). Optional here because the flattened create body also covers identity-kind endpoints, which take no ips.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Specify the list of CIDRs to restrict ingress connections. Required when creating an ip-kind proxy endpoint.
